investment_strategy: Constructive-but-selective AI stack exposure for 2025 in a moderate-volatility market (VIX ~17) and a still-demanding rate backdrop (10Y ~4.6%). Overweight profitable, lower-volatility platforms with clear AI monetization (copilots/search) and strong analyst conviction, complemented by a smaller, tactical allocation to AI compute leadership. Maintain valuation discipline, size positions to reflect regulatory/export risks, and rebalance quarterly or on thesis change.

portfolio_summary.strategy_focus: Quality-heavy AI exposure: overweight enterprise/platform monetization (MSFT, GOOGL) with disciplined compute exposure (NVDA); valuation- and risk-aware sizing under a higher-rate regime.

analysis_summary.selection_criteria: Prioritized lower volatility, strong fundamental growth, positive momentum, and STRONG_BUY analyst consensus; weighted by macro fit (rates/VIX), news sentiment, regulatory/export risks, and AI monetization clarity.
analysis_summary.market_outlook: Nasdaq momentum intact with moderate VIX; 10Y yield near 4.6% favors profitable leaders and valuation discipline. AI capex cycle and enterprise adoption support the stack; manage antitrust and geopolitics via sizing and diversification.
